title: Serve owner-authorized Timeline source previews as safe HTML in the actual Incident-to-Case local browser
goal: Close the functional gap on the runnable Incident→Case→source browser path: the endpoint opened in the browser still returned JSON. Integrate existing source-identical safe HTML rendering and stronger owner identity checks from independent PR #204 into the pre-existing source-open host in PR #203; preserve both original PR SHAs and full JSON compatibility.
invariants: The existing host authenticates with independent synthetic loopback Basic principals and independently rechecks Investigate Case, Timeline Entry and typed source-owner read on every browser source click.
New rendered HTML comes only from an already authorized owner-derived sourcePreviewResponse, never browser permissions, sourceRef, principal, redirect or untrusted Case URL.
Strengthen final sink source owner identity checks including canonical reference/kind/objectID/tenant/environment/Case; never weaken authorized JSON behavior.
Native browser Accept text/html gives escaped presentation, strict CSP, no-store and fixed safe Case return URL; application/json still returns unchanged source JSON.
Source #204 HTML code copied by byte-identical Git blobs; its original SHA and PR #203 SHA remain immutable. Only new integration candidate is modified.
No source mutation, Evidence custody, audit storage, real IAM or production deployment. Unsafe/denied/canceled request yields no protected preview.
Do not change Go toolchain or disable reachable-vulnerability SCA; take modern, already green #203 chain as the Git parent.
security_properties: Host's Command-only principal must never acquire Investigate source.read; anonymous/wrong Case/Entry/raw-reference parameter rejected without content in HTML and JSON.
Avoid script, dangerous links and cache or referer leaks via html/template CSP default-src none, frame none, tokenless return URL, no-store and no-referrer.
Validate owner reference against the independently authorized visible Entry at response time; no identity ambiguity even with a corrupt synthetic owner registry.
Cross-source and cross-tenant denials are indistinguishable from missing sources.

migration.rationale: Presentation on existing fixed GET /demo-source-open, no persistent schema change.

rollback.strategy: Revert this child integration, restore JSON-only source opens while retaining upstream #203 source-link path and Git history.
verification: JSON source API exact fields unchanged
No unsafe HTML enabled by rollback

Reconciled integration path without changing frozen #203/#204, inherited modern Go/SCA gate from #203
